title: About/Team Page
content: Build about/team page. Hero: large headline, mission statement, background image or gradient. Story section: company history with timeline or narrative paragraphs, milestone highlights. Values section: 3-4 value cards with icons and descriptions. Team section: grid of team member cards with photos, names, roles, social links. Investors/partners section. Press mentions. Office locations with images. Join us CTA linking to careers.

variants.simple: Create about page with company story, mission, and team members.
variants.detailed: Build about/team page. Hero: large headline, mission statement, background image or gradient. Story section: company history with timeline or narrative paragraphs, milestone highlights. Values section: 3-4 value cards with icons and descriptions. Team section: grid of team member cards with photos, names, roles, social links. Investors/partners section. Press mentions. Office locations with images. Join us CTA linking to careers.
variants.advanced: Build comprehensive about/team page showcasing company culture. Hero section: min-h-[60vh] flex items-center, background image with overlay or gradient. Content: headline "About [Company]" (text-5xl font-bold text-white), mission statement (text-xl text-white/90 max-w-2xl), optional scroll indicator. Mission/vision section: py-20 bg-gray-50, centered content max-w-3xl, "Our Mission" heading, large quote-style mission statement (text-2xl font-light leading-relaxed), vision paragraph. Story section: timeline or narrative format. Timeline: vertical line (left on desktop, center on mobile), year markers, event descriptions alternating sides. Or narrative: two-column layout with images, paragraph blocks telling founding story, growth milestones. Values section: py-20, grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-8. Value card: icon in colored circle (w-16 h-16), value name (text-xl font-semibold), description paragraph. Example values: Innovation, Integrity, Customer Focus, Collaboration. Team section: "Meet the Team" heading centered. Leadership: larger cards (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3), photo (aspect-square rounded-xl), name (font-semibold), title (text-gray-600), bio paragraph, social links (LinkedIn, Twitter). Full team: smaller cards (grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-6), photo, name, title. Department grouping optional. Hover effect: reveal social links or additional info. Investors/partners: logo grid (grayscale, hover color), "Backed by" or "Partners" heading. Press mentions: "As seen in" with publication logos and quote snippets. Office locations: grid of location cards with office photos, city name, address. Culture gallery: photo grid showcasing team events, office, culture. Join us CTA: full-width banner "Want to join our team?" with "View Open Positions" button linking to careers. Footer: standard site footer. Accessibility: proper heading hierarchy, alt text on all images, team member cards focusable.
